desc:
Ongoing product listing care keeps your catalog current with regular uploads, price and stock updates and fixes. Ecom Swift LLC starts with a fixed sprint: we set up a simple routine with you, complete the first rounds of work and write down the rules we followed.

## What is ongoing listing care?

Ongoing listing care is the routine upkeep of your product catalog. It covers adding new products, updating prices and stock, retiring items that are no longer sold, fixing broken images and links, and keeping tags and collections tidy. It is the work that nobody schedules but everybody notices when it is missing.

We offer it as a starter sprint. A sprint is a fixed block of work with a defined scope, not an open-ended subscription. When the sprint ends, you can continue the routine yourself or ask us for a quote for monthly care.

## Why catalogs go stale

Most stores start with a burst of attention. Products are added, photos are shot and descriptions are polished. Then orders arrive, support emails pile up and the catalog is left behind. Prices fall out of step with suppliers, a discontinued item stays on sale, a new range waits in a spreadsheet for weeks.

Shoppers feel the effects. They find sold-out products, missing sizes, outdated seasonal banners and links that go nowhere. Each of these tells a visitor that nobody is tending the store, and that is not an impression a buyer wants before paying.

## How regular upkeep affects the store

Fresh listings give shoppers and search engines a reason to return. New products appear when the season changes, not a month later. Accurate stock prevents orders you cannot fill. Prices that follow your costs protect margin, and fixed broken images keep the pages looking cared for.

A routine also saves effort. When updates arrive in a predictable rhythm, from a shared request sheet, nothing waits until it becomes an emergency. Small fixes are cheaper than large rescues, and a catalog health check each round catches problems while they are still small.

## What a good listing care routine includes

- A shared request sheet where you list the changes you want.
- A fixed rhythm, such as one update round each week or each fortnight.
- New product uploads with titles, images, variants and collections.
- Price, stock and tag changes applied from your sheet.
- Out-of-date products drafted or archived, not left half visible.
- Broken image and link fixes.
- A catalog health check in each round, looking for gaps and duplicates.
- Seasonal collection refreshes when a new range arrives.
- Short written notes on the rules we followed, so anyone can repeat them.
- A clear record of what changed in each round.

## How the sprint works

We begin by agreeing how you will send requests: a shared sheet, a folder of photos or a short list by message. We set up the routine and confirm what counts as one update round.

Then we carry out the rounds. The Basic package covers one round of updates, such as a batch of new products, price and stock changes and archiving old items, plus short routine notes. Standard has two rounds with a weekly rhythm, fixes for broken images and links and a shared request sheet. Premium has three rounds with a health check in each, a seasonal collection refresh and a quote for monthly care. The sprint price covers the work in the package only, and anything beyond it is quoted first.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send requests in one place, using the same sheet each time.
- Put dates on price changes so we apply them at the right moment.
- Tell us when a product is discontinued.
- Read the routine notes so you can continue between sprints.

**Avoid:**
- Sending changes through many different channels.
- Asking for large new projects inside a small update round.
- Leaving stock updates until a customer complains.
- Editing the same products in the store while a round is in progress.

## Who this service is for

It suits a busy owner who adds a seasonal range a few times a year and wants it handled cleanly. It suits a shop with a supplier whose prices and stock change often. It also suits a merchant who is not sure whether monthly help is worthwhile and wants to try a fixed first step.

## What we need from you

Send your first batch of changes and tell us how you would like to communicate. We ask for collaborator, staff or team access to your store and never need your password. You keep ownership of the store and all the files, and you decide after the sprint whether to continue.
